title: DWP ‘cyber incident’ knocks almost all pensions and benefits systems offline
summary: Department for Work and Pensions urges people to be alert to scams related to outage and contact helpline with urgent difficulties
byline: Rowena Mason, Aletha Adu, Ben Quinn and Patrick Butler

blocks.text:
Department for Work and Pensions urges people to be alert to scams related to outage and contact helpline with urgent difficulties

  • Tell us: have you been affected by the DWP ‘cyber incident’

Benefits and pensions claimants have faced chaos after the system was hit by a “serious cyber incident”, fuelling concerns about the UK government’s ability to defend itself against malicious attacks.

The government took its portal down late on Thursday after detecting “unusual activity”, meaning anyone trying to check their state pension, make an application for disability benefits or claim universal credit on Friday was unable to do so.
